test_seq2seq_model_torchscript_export: test the Seq2SeqModel torchscript export by running model.torchscriptify() and calling the scripted model with token inputs
test_seq2seq_model_with_contextual_embed: test the Seq2SeqModel with contextual token embeddings by passing ByteTokenTensorizer inputs to the scripted model
test_seq2seq_model_with_dict_feature: test the Seq2SeqModel with gazetteer dictionary features by passing GazetteerTensorizer inputs to the scripted model
test_seq2seq_model_eval_predictions: test the Seq2SeqModel eval stage predictions by verifying get_pred returns None tuples during evaluation
test_seq2seq_model_incremental_state_res: test the Seq2SeqModel incremental state reset by calling decoder.reset_incremental_states() and verifying consistent predictions
